There's not much of a secret, the answer is Habit. We will always try to live our day in search of energy while spending as little as possible. When you do something repetitive once and it becomes a habit, your body will automatically want to repeat it recently because it is much safer and "inside your bubble" to do your already installed habits than to try something new and unfamiliar. Even if this something new is better and more healthy. Don't try to improve from 0 to 100% all at once. I suggest you think about who you want to become and ask yourself what habits should I have to get there? Always start as simple as possible (important) And so you will gradually build yourself.  vice versa either, if you already practice a bad habit like scrolling +2 hours on tiktok, this habit becomes part of your personality and it becomes increasingly difficult to remove, but if you want to improve, uninstall the apps or install something that controls your daily use. You have to focus on habits
